keyPhrases.text: Few musicals have the range, idiosyncrasy and emotional punch
brings down the house with a bravura comic performance
may be the best gay-themed musical ever written
Borle sometimes hits Marvin's meanness too hard

reasoning: Strong positive review with superlative praise ('best gay-themed musical ever written', 'extraordinary', 'tremendously moving') but acknowledges specific flaws in production choices and performance. The critic clearly recommends the show despite minor criticisms, placing it firmly in 4/5 star territory.
